text_block_list.text: Curren Bouquetd'or had been caring for the flowers all on her own. Even if watching over her was all I could do, as her Trainer—
choice_data_list: I can't just go on knowing absolutely nothing about flowers
I can't just go on knowing absolutely nothing about flowers

text_block_list.text: With that in mind, today I decided to visit a botanical garden in the next town famous for its flower collection. When I arrived at the nearest bus stop, standing there was—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer? 
What brings you all the way out here…?
choice_data_list: Bouquet… Are you on your way to the botanical garden, too?
Bouquet… Are you on your way to the botanical garden, too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My — you are on your way there too, Trainer? 
What an — incredible coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: But unfortunately — it seems the bus schedule has been temporarily changed, so we'll have to wait quite a while, I'm afraid.
choice_data_list: Eh, is that so…

text_block_list.text: Things weren't exactly going according to plan… but this, too, must have been fate. Besides, I was sure to learn a lot by looking at the flowers with her.
choice_data_list: If you don't mind… is it okay if we wait for the bus together?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes — of course. Since we have this rare opportunity, 
let's just relax and have a nice chat.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I heard they have beautiful flower fields there, so it's been on my mind for a while… But since it's quite far from the academy, this is actually my first time going.
choice_data_list: I've actually started taking an interest in flowers recently, too
I've actually started taking an interest in flowers recently, too

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My — so that was it. 
…Ehehe, I see.
(Peep, peep…)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah… There's a kingfisher over there. 
What a beautiful shade of lapis lazuli — isn't it adorable?
choice_data_list: Yeah… I feel like I could watch it all day
Yeah… I feel like I could watch it all day

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—! 
…Um, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'd love nemophilas, too! Just like the kingfisher, they're these tiny, beautiful blue flowers—!
choice_data_list: Eh…?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh………… 
…I-I'm sorry. Since you mentioned that you'd taken an interest in flowers—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to share everything I knew about them, and I got a bit carried away… I was coming on a little too strong, wasn't I?
choice_data_list: <size=38>Not at all, it's actually a huge help! Thank you!</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? Oh, I'm so glad… Um — Once we get there, 
I'd love to look for those nemophilas with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—At this time of year, the roses should be at their peak. 
Satsuki azaleas, and lavender too — oh?
choice_data_list: Huh? The bus is already here!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It came sooner than I expected… 
I'm sorry, I feel like I've been doing all the talking.
choice_data_list: You've just made me even more excited to see the flowers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes — I'm so excited, too. 
—Well then, shall we get on the bus?
And so, swaying along on the bus, we finally reached the botanical garden's reception desk but…
choice_data_list: Eh, we can't go in yet?

text_block_list.name: Receptionist
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry, but the lighting inspection is taking longer than scheduled… It will likely be another hour or so before you can enter the garden…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer… what should we do? 
I don't mind waiting myself, but—
choice_data_list: <size=40>If you don't mind, Bouquet, shall we wait?</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah — then I'll go get a pamphlet for us. 
Let's sit and read it on that bench over there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Many botanical gardens like this one replant their flowers with every passing season. It says,『Experience the changing seasons through the flowers』—
choice_data_list: I see… In that case, we can enjoy coming here no matter how many times we visit
I see… In that case, we can enjoy coming here no matter how many times we visit

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Hehe, that's true. The flowers in full bloom change depending on the season, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In autumn — there are the autumn leaves, of course, along with dahlias and cosmos — it's the season when these vibrant flowers bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And even in the harsh winter — beautiful flowers still bloom quietly. Just looking at camellias and cyclamens — always warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It takes a long time for the seasons to run their course, 
but — there are so many joys to look forward to along the way.
choice_data_list: Yeah… Phew
Yeah… Phew

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry… Trainer, are you feeling hot? 
We've been talking a lot, so maybe something to drink—
choice_data_list: Ah, in that case—

text_block_list.text: I took a bottle of water I'd bought at the reception desk out of my bag. Figuring she must be thirsty, too, I offered it to her, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Here, I got this at the reception desk earlier — eh?
choice_data_list: Wait… You bought one too, Bouquet?
Wait… You bought one too, Bouquet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah… I was just worried you might be feeling hot, Trainer…
choice_data_list: And I was just worried you might be getting thirsty, Bouquet…
And I was just worried you might be getting thirsty, Bouquet…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah………… Ah — so that was it…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Well then… shall we do a little swap?
choice_data_list: …Hehe, sure
…Hehe, sure

text_block_list.name: Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! 
The inspection is complete, so you are free to enter now.
choice_data_list: Oh, has it been that long already?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That went by surprisingly fast, didn't it— 
Well then, shall we head in? To our destination for today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Amazing…! 
Every single one of them — so incredibly vibrant…!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Are those yellow flowers gerberas…? 
I can see red poppies further back, too—!
choice_data_list: This is… amazing…!
This is… amazing…!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah — that's right, the nemophila flowers! 
Trainer, let's go look for them…!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go!
Yeah, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Wow — we found them, Trainer! 
Look, there are so many tiny little flowers — they're so adorable.
choice_data_list: You're right, they are adorable!
You're right, they are adorable!

text_block_list.text: As we continued our stroll through the garden, comforted by the beautiful flowers… I felt like I could finally understand how much she loved them, even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's already getting dark, isn't it? Even though the sun was beating down on us just a little while ago—
choice_data_list: Well, a lot happened today, after all
Well, a lot happened today, after all

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah — hehe, you're right. 
We did wait quite a long time before we could see the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: But — I didn't mind the wait in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Honestly…… not at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: While talking with you, Trainer — the scenery here became even more vivid in my mind. And—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Even my imagination… completely surpassed what I'd imagined.
choice_data_list: <size=40>…Let's come here together again sometime!</size>
<size=40>…Let's come here together again sometime!</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Hehe, yes. 
I'm very much — looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The bus back — should be here in about twenty minutes. 
We should be able to get on much sooner than we did on the way here.

That being said, we still had to wait for the bus… 
and it would take quite some time to get back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: …Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If you'd like — could we talk some more?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
On the way back — please tell me some of your stories, Trainer. 
Like the flowers you grew to like today. And—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ……Even things that aren't about flowers.
choice_data_list: Bouquet… yeah, of course!
Bouquet… yeah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Hehe. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sure this time, too… we'll arrive before we know it.
And so, we waited for the bus, chatting away. By the time we finally arrived near the academy, the sun was already beginning to set, but—
The sunset we looked up at together — perhaps it was just my imagination, but it seemed so much more beautiful than usual.
